name: com.zen.plugins.adzative
description: AdMob native ads (Android: GMA Next-Gen SDK, iOS: Google Mobile Ads SDK) in 5 formats drawn over the Unity view without losing focus: banner, MREC, interstitial, app open, rewarded. Pools, slots on Canvas RectTransforms, 15 layouts, per-placement analytics. Can run under a host waterfall (manualLoad + externalSdkInit), e.g. zen-unity Base AdZative.
